responsibility: This header defines the abstract backend interface used by the Rust frontend to construct GCC IR-facing entities without depending directly on GCC tree-building details. It specifies the stable API for creating types, expressions, variables, labels, functions, statements, global definitions, and export data, along with the `typed_identifier` helper and `Bvariable` references, so later frontend passes can lower Rust AST/HIR/typechecked constructs into backend objects through a single virtual interface.
